text:
I'm sorry, that's scary. Please contact your vet or your local poison control right away, before anything else. Pothos is not pet-safe, so don't wait to see whether symptoms appear. It helps to have the plant name and how much was chewed ready when you call.

Because this is a safety issue, I'm escalating your case to a Support Lead now. They will follow up with you, but please don't wait for them before contacting the vet or poison control.

I don't have guidance beyond that on symptoms or treatment, so the vet or poison control is the right place for that.
